slides.headline: RAID Storage vs Real Backups
slides.myth: Having RAID-10 storage on your server means you donât need to configure website backups.
slides.fact: RAID protects against physical drive failure, not accidental file deletion, database corruption, or malicious ransomware. You always need separate backups.

caption:
A common server mistake that costs businesses dearly! ð

RAID storage mirrors your data across multiple hard drives so the server stays on if one disk dies. But if a file is deleted or hacked, it is deleted across all disks instantly.

Always maintain independent off-site backups. HAAN Web Hosting offers automated backup management.
